tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL TERMS AND CONDITIONS AS PER TENDER DOCUMENTS
BIDDER SHOULD QUOTE RATE IN FORMATE OF PER DAY PER PERSON IN RUPEES ONLY

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Experience Certificates/ The Bidder should have minimum 3 Years Experience for providing food to the 100 beds Hospital.
Catering Business Permission Certificate /Trade Licence issued by Competent authority.
Self declaration stating that the firm is not Black listed with any Government/ Quasi Govt. Organizations. on Rs.1,500/- Bond with Notary.
Firm/ Company/ Organization should not be facing any judicial trial or part-mental enquiry. The firm should submit a self declaration in support of this.
Self Attested copy of Address(Office &Residence) and phone No
Co-operative societies have to submit Financial Soundness Certificate issued by Compliant authority
FSSAI Permission issued by local Food safety department.
The Annual Financial turnover of the bidder should be minimum of Rs.30 Lakh per year. For the last each three years.With Financial Statements Certified by C.A(2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 FY)
